title: The capillary $L_p$ dual Minkowski problem for $p>q$ in higher dimensions
summary: We prove that the capillary $L_p$ dual Minkowski problem in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$, $n\geq3$, admits a unique positive smooth strictly convex solution for any prescribed positive smooth function $f$ when $p>q$ and the contact angle satisfies $θ\in(0,π/2)$. Earlier results for $p>q$ either required the additional condition $q\leq1$ or were restricted to $n=2$. We reduce the problem to a Monge--Ampère type equation with a Robin boundary condition on a spherical cap.
